audit_item: A10 / historical instrument rules manifest JSON integrity
finding: Historical execution-rule manifests were parsed with default JSON semantics. Duplicate source or event fields could be silently overwritten, changing tick/step/fee/margin/effective-time facts consumed by the simulated environment.
change: load_rules now uses the data package recursive duplicate-key parser, normalizes invalid/ambiguous JSON to DataError, and validates the root manifest shape before processing sources/events.

verification.ruff: passed for historical loader and full factory test module
verification.mypy: passed with import-untyped disabled for untyped installed dependencies

scope: Synthetic rules manifest and existing synthetic historical fixtures only; no real market or evaluation payload accessed.
